name: higgsfield
description: An asynchronous API providing developer access to 50+ video and image generation models via a single balance and unified auth.

evidence.claim: Generate images and videos through one authenticated, asynchronous API.
Authenticate server-side API requests with your Higgsfield key and secret. Create and manage API credentials in Higgsfield Console.
The Higgsfield API is a self-serve API for developers that provides direct access to more than 50 current video and image generation models with pay-as-you-go billing in US dollars.

notes: API requests require both an API key and secret (or a combined format). Billing is pay-as-you-go with balance top-ups.
